AAUSBAccessory.doc: A class that represents a USB accessory.

AAUSBAccessoryManager.doc: A class your app uses to manage USB accessories and the listener objects for those accessories.

AAUSBAccessoryMatchingCriteria.doc: A class that represents the accessory matching criteria for a USB accessory.

AAUSBAccessoryListener.doc: A class that conforms to the framework’s USB accessory listener protocol can listen to the accessory events.

-closeWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Closes all connections to the USB accessory for this process.

-createXPCRepresentation.doc: Creates an encoded representation of the USB accessory.

-initWithXPCRepresentation:.doc: Creates a USB accessory from an XPC representation.

-openWithServiceQueue:completionHandler:.doc: Opens a connection to the USB accessory for this process to access it exclusively.

-initWithDeviceMatchingDictionary:.doc: Initializes a criteria object using a USB device matching dictionary.

-initWithDeviceMatchingDictionary:interf.doc: Initializes a criteria object using USB interface matching dictionaries, for the provided USB device matching criteria.

AAUSBAccessory.Event.doc: Events that represent accessory connection and disconnection.

configurationDescriptorData.doc: Returns the currently selected configuration descriptor data.

init(XPCRepresentation:).doc: Creates a USB accessory from an XPC representation.

init(coder:).doc: Creates a new USB accessory with the provided coder.

registryID.doc: Returns the IORegistry ID for the USB accessory.

events(matching:).doc: Returns an asynchronous list of events that match the provided criteria.

sharedManager.doc: Returns the shared USB accessory manager object for this process.

AAUSBAccessoryMatchingCriteria.DeviceMat.doc: A structure you provide that enumerates which device characteristics to search for.

AAUSBAccessoryMatchingCriteria.Interface.doc: A structure you provide that enumerates which device interface characteristics to search for.

AAUSBAccessoryMatchingCriteriaInterfaceM.doc: Values that represent options for performing interface matching using interface matching criteria.

init(deviceMatchingCriteria:).doc: Initializes a criteria object with the provided USB device matching properties.

init(deviceMatchingCriteria:interfaceMat.doc: Initializes a criteria object using USB interface matching criteria, for the given USB device matching criteria.
